Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used iTRAQ 8-plex labeling with HiRIEF pre-fractionation. While the results discuss phosphorylation (e.g., VE-cadherin Y658), this was performed via Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and Western Blot, not via MS-based phosphoproteome enrichment. The MS analysis was an unbiased discovery proteome.

scope: Total protein was extracted from the intima-media layer of 21 patients

The novel liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry-based proteomic approach, HiRIEF LC-MS/MS, which is an unbiased discovery method with deep proteome coverage, allowed the detection and quantification of 2894 proteins in the intima-media of non-dilated and dilated ascending aortas.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS was total protein extracted from the intima-media layer of the aortic wall. While the study focuses on the intima, the extraction is described as 'total protein' from a tissue layer, which corresponds to a whole cell lysate/bulk proteome scope rather than a specific subcellular fraction or purified complex.
